source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever this model is picked to shoot, you may activate this ability: until the phase ends its attacks get +1 to [Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls), and once those attacks are resolved you roll a D6, with this model suffering D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on a 2+.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 9 of 157 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
